2026_01_BUF_HOU.headline: Buffalo’s improvisational offense faces a healthy Houston roster and a narrow execution margin
2026_01_BUF_HOU.paragraph1: The Bills carry T.J. Sanders, Ty Johnson and Jordan Hancock as questionable, while the Texans reached the final report without a player carrying a game-status designation. Houston therefore has the cleaner availability sheet, but Buffalo’s offensive challenge is more about style than injury count. The Bills can tilt the matchup by creating second-reaction throws and quarterback movement that break Houston’s coverage structure; the Texans can answer by winning early downs, compressing the pocket and preventing Buffalo from turning broken plays into explosives.
2026_01_BUF_HOU.model_rationale: Buffalo can justify the edge by extending plays beyond Houston’s initial coverage call and creating scramble-drill stress that conventional down-and-distance defense cannot fully control.
